identity: A self-contained experimental web studio for fictional worlds, sensory systems, and playable atmospheres.
production_rules: Each production must stand on its own without project exposition.
Deterministic systems are preferred over decorative randomness.
Sound must require an explicit user gesture and remain optional.
Reduced-motion, keyboard use, mobile safety, and reversible implementation are mandatory.
No payments, conversion logic, private source material, or diagnosis/treatment claims.

current_production.title: The Observatory of Lost Weather
current_production.creative_premise: A fictional observatory measures weather systems that violate ordinary time, direction, and causality.
current_production.independence_basis: The work contains no Mirror Cartographer terminology, project explanation, account flow, research interface, analytics, or conversion path.
